# FIMA Lab

Finance ∙ Intelligence ∙ Math ∙ Analytics

Welcome to FIMA Lab. Founded by Prof. Huei-Wen Teng in 2010 and now based at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan, we bring together statistics, machine learning, financial engineering, and FinTech to turn data into practical, evidence-based answers. We publish with collaborators around the world, mentor students, and work with industry on real problems. Researchers, students, and companies are all welcome. Get in touch at [hwteng@nycu.edu.tw](mailto:hwteng@nycu.edu.tw).

Our research spans four pillars, and lab members collaborate across them.

### 1. **Explainable AI & FinTech**

We build credit-scoring and default-prediction models that keep machine-learning accuracy yet stay transparent for banks and regulators. Related work: interpretable cluster-then-predict credit scoring ([IRFA 2024](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.irfa.2023.103005)), AI Act–compliant scoring ([AEL 2026](https://doi.org/10.1080/13504851.2026.2710263)), and US bank-failure prediction ([AEL 2024](https://doi.org/10.1080/13504851.2023.2186353)).

### 2. **Trading & Portfolio Management**

We forecast stock returns, earnings and Bitcoin volatility from market data and text, and build portfolios on those forecasts. Related work: news embeddings for intraday Bitcoin volatility ([FRL 2026](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.frl.2026.110976)), GPT-4o mini for Taiwan earnings ([JCSA 2026](https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5312509)), and risk-parity strategies with risk factors ([Journal of Risk 2025](https://doi.org/10.21314/JOR.2025.006)).

### 3. **Financial Market Risk Management**

We measure tail risk, Value-at-Risk and expected shortfall, for Basel capital, and study how digital assets are regulated. Related work: Bitcoin tail risk under Basel ([FRL 2025](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.frl.2025.108528)), digital-asset risks and regulation ([Financial Innovation 2026](https://doi.org/10.1186/s40854-025-00848-y)), and importance sampling for portfolio risk ([Computational Economics 2023](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10614-022-10294-y)).

### 4. **Financial Derivatives Pricing**

We design faster, more accurate Monte Carlo methods to price and hedge options, including cryptocurrency options. Related work: unbiased Greeks ([Finance and Stochastics 2011](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00780-010-0137-5)), optimal importance sampling ([Quantitative Finance 2016](https://doi.org/10.1080/14697688.2015.1136077)), and stochastic-volatility hedging of Deribit BTC options ([Journal of Futures and Options 2023](https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.4271856)).

📚 Our publications: [Publications](https://venteng.github.io/Publication.html)

## Interested in Joining? Let’s Make an Impact Together!

1. Enrolling in my *Machine Learning & FinTech* course is a great way to build relevant skills for our research — it’s highly recommended.
2. **MUST** attend weekly lab meeting on Wednesday afternoon. 
3. If you are from a different department, we encourage you to review the suggested [course plan](https://imf.nycu.edu.tw/imf/ch/app/artwebsite/view?module=artwebsite&id=5997&serno=b1153a31-aa1c-46a2-8205-b611f9cffa7c) to help build a solid foundation in finance.
4. Email me! ✉️ [hwteng@nycu.edu.tw](mailto:hwteng@nycu.edu.tw)
